name: DS Cluster D11b: Splits, IPOs, Ticker Events
description: Tests: splits outputs, ipos outputs, ticker_events outputs. All sparse corporate event sources. Run with: --start 2024-05-01 --end 2024-08-31 (NVDA 10:1 split on 2024-06-10).
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D11b: Splits, IPOs, Ticker Events
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === SPLITS ===
sp = splits()()
had_split = is_valid(sp.split_ratio)

# === IPOs ===
ipo = ipos()()
had_ipo = is_valid(ipo.final_issue_price)

# === TICKER EVENTS ===
te = ticker_events()()
had_event = is_valid(te.event_type)

# === REPORTERS ===
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Ratio", dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title="Split"
    )
)((sp.split_ratio, had_split))

histogram(category="Events", title="Close", bins=20)(close)
